 Order
Today, when the matter is taken up for hearing, learned counsel for the petitioner seeks permission of this Court to withdraw this Writ Petition and she has also made an endorsement to that effect.
In view of the endorsement made by the learned counsel for the petitioner, the Writ Petition stands dismissed as withdrawn.
However, there shall be no order as to costs.
